title: Echoes of Tomorrow
tagline: Every memory is a puzzle piece from the future.
creator: The Duffer Brothers
description: A group of scientists discover memories from the future hidden inside an ancient device, unravelling an impending cataclysm.

title: Northbound
tagline: The question is not where, but when.
creator: Baran bo Odar, Jantje Friese
description: A detective returns to a remote hometown to solve a mysterious disappearance that ties back to four estranged families across generations.

title: House of Shadows
tagline: Secrets rot faster in the dark.
creator: Mike Flanagan
description: A wealthy family gathers in an isolated mountain estate after receiving an anonymous ultimatum revealing their darkest crimes.

title: Red District
creator: Craig Mazin
description: An undercover agent enters the most dangerous syndicate in the city only to discover corruption reaches the highest halls of justice.

title: The Silent Ocean
creator: Jonathan Nolan
description: A deep-sea research team discovers an extraterrestrial structure resting quietly beneath the Mariana Trench.

title: Second Life
creator: Sam Esmail
description: Two complete strangers wake up in different cities plagued by vivid, intertwined memories of a life they never lived.

title: The Last of Us
tagline: When you're lost in the darkness, look for the light.
creator: Craig Mazin, Neil Druckmann
description: After a global pandemic destroys civilization, a hardened survivor takes charge of a 14-year-old girl who may be humanity's last hope.

title: Severance
tagline: Please do not attempt to adjust your memory.
creator: Dan Erickson
description: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives.

title: Breaking Bad
creator: Vince Gilligan
description: A chemistry teacher diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer turns to manufacturing and selling methamphetamine with a former student.

title: Succession
creator: Jesse Armstrong
description: The Roy family is known for controlling the biggest media and entertainment company in the world. However, their world changes when their aging father steps down.

title: Arcane
creator: Christian Linke, Alex Yee
description: Set in the utopian region of Piltover and the oppressed underground of Zaun, the story follows the origins of two iconic League champions.

title: Shōgun
tagline: Fate brought them together. Honor will tear them apart.
creator: Rachel Kondo, Justin Marks
description: When a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby fishing village, Lord Yoshii Toranaga discovers secrets that could tip the scales of power in feudal Japan.

title: The Bear
creator: Christopher Storer
description: A young chef from the fine dining world comes home to Chicago to run his family Italian beef sandwich shop after a heartbreaking death in his family.

title: True Detective
tagline: Touch darkness and darkness touches you back.
creator: Nic Pizzolatto
description: An anthology series in which police investigations unearth the personal and professional secrets of those involved, both within and outside the law.

title: Loki
creator: Michael Waldron
description: The mercurial villain Loki resumes his role as the God of Mischief in a new series that takes place after the events of Avengers: Endgame.

title: Chernobyl
tagline: What is the cost of lies?
creator: Craig Mazin
description: In April 1986, an explosion at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant in the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics becomes one of the world's worst man-made catastrophes.

title: Mindhunter
tagline: To catch a monster you have to get inside his head.
creator: Joe Penhall
description: In the late 1970s two FBI agents expand criminal science by delving into the psychology of murder and getting uneasily close to all-too-real monsters.

title: Fallout
creator: Graham Wagner, Geneva Robertson-Dworet
description: In a future, post-apocalyptic Los Angeles brought about by nuclear decimation, citizens must live in underground bunkers to protect themselves.

title: Fargo
creator: Noah Hawley
description: Various chronicles of deception, intrigue and murder in and around frozen Minnesota. Yet all of these tales mysteriously lead back one way or another to Fargo, North Dakota.

title: Dark
tagline: The end is the beginning and the beginning is the end.
creator: Baran bo Odar, Jantje Friese
description: A family saga with a supernatural twist, set in a German town where the disappearance of two young children exposes the relationships among four families.

title: Game of Thrones
creator: David Benioff, D.B. Weiss
description: Nine noble families fight for control over the lands of Westeros, while an ancient enemy returns after being dormant for millennia.

title: House of the Dragon
creator: Ryan J. Condal, George R.R. Martin
description: An internal succession war within House Targaryen at the height of its power, 172 years before the birth of Daenerys Targaryen.

title: Stranger Things
creator: The Duffer Brothers
description: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces and one strange little girl.

title: Westworld
creator: Jonathan Nolan, Lisa Joy
description: At the intersection of the near future and the reimagined past, explore a world in which every human appetite can be indulged without consequence.

title: The Mandalorian
tagline: Bounty hunting is a complicated profession.
creator: Jon Favreau
description: The travels of a lone bounty hunter in the outer reaches of the galaxy, far from the authority of the New Republic.

title: Better Call Saul
tagline: Criminal lawyer, in every sense of the word.
creator: Vince Gilligan, Peter Gould
description: The trials and tribulations of criminal lawyer Jimmy McGill in the years leading up to his fateful run-in with Walter White and Jesse Pinkman.

title: Peaky Blinders
tagline: By order of the Peaky Blinders.
creator: Steven Knight
description: A gangster family epic set in 1900s England, centering on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby.

title: The Penguin
creator: Lauren LeFranc
description: Following the events of The Batman (2022), Oz Cobb, alias the Penguin, makes a violent play to seize the reins of the crime world in Gotham.

title: The Boys
creator: Eric Kripke
description: A fun and irreverent take on what happens when superheroes abuse their superpowers rather than use them for good.

title: The White Lotus
tagline: Paradise is a state of mind.
creator: Mike White
description: Set in a tropical resort, it follows the exploits of various guests and employees over the span of a week as dark secrets unravel.

title: Mr. Robot
creator: Sam Esmail
description: Elliot, a brilliant but unstable cybersecurity engineer and vigilante hacker, becomes a key figure in a complex game of global chaos when he is recruited by an underground hacktivist group.

title: The Sopranos
tagline: If one family doesn't kill him... the other family will.
creator: David Chase
description: New Jersey mob boss Tony Soprano deals with personal and professional issues in his home and business life that affect his mental state, leading him to seek professional psychiatric counseling.

title: The Wire
creator: David Simon
description: The Baltimore drug scene, as seen through the eyes of drug dealers and law enforcement officers.

title: Band of Brothers
tagline: They depended on each other. And the world depended on them.
creator: Tom Hanks, Steven Spielberg
description: The story of Easy Company of the U.S. Army 101st Airborne Division and their mission in World War II Europe, from Operation Overlord through V-J Day.

title: Fleabag
tagline: A hilarious and poignant comedy about modern life.
creator: Phoebe Waller-Bridge
description: A dry-witted woman, known only as Fleabag, has no filter as she navigates life and love in London while trying to cope with tragedy.

title: Black Mirror
tagline: The future is bright. The future is terrifying.
creator: Charlie Brooker
description: An anthology series exploring a twisted, high-tech multiverse where humanity's greatest innovations and darkest instincts collide.

title: Sherlock
tagline: A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner in 21st century London.
creator: Mark Gatiss, Steven Moffat
description: A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner solving crime in 21st century London.

title: Narcos
tagline: There's no business like blow business.
creator: Carlo Bernard, Chris Brancato, Doug Miro
description: A chronicled look at the criminal exploits of Colombian drug lord Pablo Escobar, as well as the many other drug kingpins who plagued the country through the years.

title: Marvel's Daredevil
creator: Drew Goddard
description: A blind lawyer by day, vigilante by night. Matt Murdock fights the crime of New York as Daredevil.

title: Invincible
creator: Robert Kirkman
description: An adult animated series based on the Skybound/Image comic about a teenager whose father is the most powerful superhero on the planet.

title: Ted Lasso
creator: Brendan Hunt, Joe Kelly, Bill Lawrence, Jason Sudeikis
description: American college football coach Ted Lasso heads to London to manage AFC Richmond, a struggling English Premier League football team.

title: Squid Game
creator: Hwang Dong-hyuk
description: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits with deadly high stakes.

title: Twin Peaks
tagline: A town where everyone knows everyone and nothing is what it seems.
creator: David Lynch, Mark Frost
description: An idiosyncratic FBI agent investigates the murder of a young woman in the even more idiosyncratic town of Twin Peaks.

title: Hannibal
creator: Bryan Fuller
description: Explores the early relationship between renowned psychiatrist Hannibal Lecter and a young FBI criminal profiler who is haunted by his ability to empathize with serial killers.

title: The Crown
creator: Peter Morgan
description: Follows the political rivalries and romance of Queen Elizabeth II's reign and the events that shaped the second half of the twentieth century.

title: Dexter
creator: James Manos Jr.
description: A Miami-based blood splatter expert for the police department solves crimes by day and commits them at night as a vigilante serial killer.

title: The Office
tagline: A mockumentary on a group of typical office workers.
creator: Greg Daniels, Ricky Gervais, Stephen Merchant
description: A mockumentary on a group of typical office workers, where the workday consists of ego clashes, inappropriate behavior, and tedium.

title: Arcane: Season 2
creator: Christian Linke, Alex Yee
description: The monumental final chapter of Vi and Jinx as the war between Piltover and Zaun reaches its fiery, inevitable climax.

title: House of the Dragon: Season 2
creator: Ryan J. Condal, George R.R. Martin
description: The Dance of the Dragons begins. The Targaryen dynasty fractures into civil war as Green and Black factions take flight.

title: Dark: The Complete Cycle
tagline: The end is the beginning, and the beginning is the end.
creator: Baran bo Odar, Jantje Friese
description: A family saga with a supernatural twist, set in a German town where the disappearance of two young children exposes the relationships among four families.
